scope: Remove outlines, about 2px material blur, four native glass capsules plus one shared idle capsule, slower nonlinear motion

constraints.pixelLatencyEachSampleMs: <16 in held drag, wheel and released idle

inspection.cssOutline: src/style.css .glass border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.65); .btn also has a hairline border
inspection.shaderOutline: edgeHighlight defaults .05 (rim, glow and innerStroke); fresnel defaults 1 (environment reflection and white blend)
inspection.blur: Six separable 9-tap Gaussian iterations, spread=blurAmount*2.5; initial pixel-to-normalized mapping based on kernel variance, to be checked against rendered pixels
inspection.structure: Actual metadata and button capsules will be direct children of one persistent LiquidGlass root; no nested glass proxy panels
